paper: MIRROR: Manifold Ideal Reference ReconstructOR for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (NeurIPS 2026, arXiv 2602.02222)
training_set_in_paper: Phase 1 trains the memory bank on real images only; phase 2 trains LoRA adapters and the head on real/fake images (Stable Diffusion v1.4 fakes, JPEG q96, per the paper) with the DINOv3 backbone, memory bank and attention projector frozen. Only the released phase-2 checkpoint (checkpoint-h-cur.pth, DINOv3 ViT-H+) is evaluated here; there is no SynthScope-trained checkpoint. The paper's per-subset tables are for DINOv3-L; the README's DINOv3-H+ column is the reproduction target.
